permanent rule

units.assertion: The rule would repeal chapters NR 107 and 109 and recreate chapter NR 107.

units.assertion: The APM program regulates chemical, mechanical, physical, and biological control of aquatic organisms to protect and develop diverse and stable native aquatic plant communities.

evidence.quote:
The Aquatic Plant Management (APM) program regulates the chemical, mechanical, physical,
and biological control of aquatic organisms in order to protect and develop diverse and stable
native aquatic plant communities.

units.assertion: Chapter NR 107, Wisconsin Administrative Code, regulates chemical control.

evidence.quote: ch. NR 107, Wis. Adm. Code, which regulates chemical control

units.assertion: Chapter NR 109, Wisconsin Administrative Code, regulates burning and mechanical, physical, and manual control.

evidence.quote:
ch. NR 109, Wis. Adm. Code, which regulates burning and mechanical, physical, and manual
control.

units.assertion: The APM program is currently regulated under two separate but related administrative rules, NR 107 and NR 109.

evidence.quote:
The program is currently regulated under two separate but
related administrative rules, ch. NR 107, Wis. Adm. Code, which regulates chemical control, and
ch. NR 109, Wis. Adm. Code, which regulates burning and mechanical, physical, and manual
control.

units.assertion: The proposal unifies all control activities under consistent procedures and policies aligned with current state and federal law.

evidence.quote:
The proposed recreated ch. NR 107, Wis. Adm. Code, unifies all control activities under a
consistent set of procedures and policies that align with current state and federal law

units.assertion: The notice describes the proposal as improving administrative consistency, efficiency, and customer service.

evidence.quote:
improving
administrative consistency and efficiency as well as customer service.
